Ollama provider sends the embedding to /api/embed and maps the native reply

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.embeddingRequestFromJson("{\"input\":[\"Hello\",\"World\"],\"model\":\"ollama/all-minilm\"}")
guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
let result = try await _client.embed(_req)
debugPrint(result.data)
debugPrint(result.model)
debugPrint(result.usage?.promptTokens as Any)
```
